name: an-input
title: AnInput
description: `<an-input>` — a single-line field backed by a real native `<input>` inside the shadow root, so focus, selection, IME, autofill, `type` semantics and the on-screen keyboard all come from the platform.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial value. The attribute is read once and never written back on input.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Native type forwarded to the inner `<input>`; unknown values fall back to "text". Default: "text".

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder text forwarded to the inner `<input>`.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label. When empty no `<label>` is rendered and `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` are forwarded from the host instead.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the inner input and blocks `an-input`/`an-change`.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Makes the inner input read-only and blocks `an-input`/`an-change`.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Participates in constraint validation (`valueMissing` when empty).

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: External error state; maps to `aria-invalid="true"` and the error border.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Field name used when the value is submitted with the owning form.

attributes.name: maxlength
attributes.description: Maximum character count forwarded to the inner input. `-1` means unlimited.

attributes.name: clearable
attributes.description: Shows a clear button while the field has a value.

attributes.name: prefix
attributes.description: Text shown before the input; `slot="prefix"` takes priority over it.

attributes.name: suffix
attributes.description: Text shown after the input; `slot="suffix"` takes priority over it.

attributes.name: autocomplete
attributes.description: Autocomplete hint forwarded to the inner input.

attributes.name: spellcheck
attributes.description: Whether the platform spell-checks the value. Default: `true`.

attributes.name: inputmode
attributes.description: Virtual-keyboard hint forwarded to the inner input.

events.name: an-input
events.description: Fired on every native input; `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

events.name: an-change
events.description: Fired on native change (blur or Enter); `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

events.name: an-input-clear
events.description: Fired after an activated clear control empties the field; `an-input` and `an-change` fire first, then `detail = { value: '' }`.

slots.name: prefix
slots.description: Custom content before the input; replaces the `prefix` text.

slots.name: suffix
slots.description: Custom content after the input; replaces the `suffix` text.

cssProperties.name: --an-input-height
cssProperties.description: Control height; defaults to 2.25rem (2rem sm, 2.75rem lg).

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: Outer wrapper around the label and the control.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The visible `<label>`; rendered only when `label` is non-empty.

cssParts.name: prefix
cssParts.description: Wrapper around the prefix text or `slot="prefix"`; hidden while empty.

cssParts.name: suffix
cssParts.description: Wrapper around the suffix text or `slot="suffix"`; hidden while empty.

cssParts.name: clear
cssParts.description: The clear button; rendered only while it can clear the field.

cssParts.name: count
cssParts.description: The character counter; rendered only with `show-count`.
